rule: Shot prompts reference elements inside the contest project 'AI Film Festival 1 - Matter of Light' and nothing else.
cost: Fifteen things the film used to attach are now written into the prompt instead. That is a real loss of control — an attached reference is identical every take, a description is not. how_to_undo: Move any of the fifteen into the contest project, tell me which, and it goes back to an attached @[name](id) in one pass. design/project-folder-gap.json carries every id.
